status: SIGNED by the art lead (hand pixels, 0 MXN)

c-open-night.why_96: a 48 px tile repeats as wallpaper across the frame; 96 px = 2 x 2 painter cells
c-open-night.variants: a, b, c: every border (3 px) is the plain night #132036, so any variant meets any other with no seam. Pick one per 96 px block by a hash of the block (as the range-haze lump variants), anchored to world px so it does not swim when the frame moves.
c-open-night.frames: 1 and 2, 900 ms each (the banks move 1 px right, the hollows 1 px left); reduced motion: still
c-open-night.use: unseen cells on the first-time Companion screen only, in place of the dark table and night dots; glimpses, chips and sparkles draw over it
c-open-night.not: no dots, no dither, nothing round and lit (the five lights are the Companion's marks; the mist has no glows of its own)

c-open-pod-96.master: 32 x 32 drawn for this size, 3x nearest
c-open-pod-96.anchor_note: the foot: bottom centre of the outline; stand it on the partner ring where the 3x token's feet go
c-open-pod-96.frames: 1 and 2, 1200 ms each (warm life in the rib grooves brightens and widens); reduced motion: still (= 1)
c-open-pod-96.what: canon pod: flat cream lid on its sand rim, the dark seam, a ribbed barrel bulb wider than the lid; the neutral unread shell (fog / mist / stone) since the first pod's kind is unknown; no crown, stalk or sprout, nothing past the outline
c-open-pod-96.replaces: the built field pod at 3x (the egg-looking stand-in in the scheme mock)

turf_strip: not needed: the ring already grounds the pod and the partner; a turf strip would add a second ground line under the text block
